size.description:
The size of the component.
`small` is equivalent to the dense button styling.

sdsType.description: Color scheme of the button. Primary uses the accent color in the on stage, secondary stays neutral.

sdsStyle.description: Style of the button. ButtonToggle inherits Button's default of solid, but toggles are designed around outline and minimal, so set one of those explicitly.

sdsStage.description: Controls the toggle stage. The component is fully controlled, so keep this value in state and update it from onClick.
